== English Reflections III comparison ==
The original uses ‘hit here’ with placement in the owner's Used Pile on both player bands. The 27 January 2003 Rules Supplement directs the full revised reading ‘are instead placed’; the 2007 Appendix and January 2013 slip retain it. This expresses the intended placement as a replacement. The August 2012 Appendix explicitly states ‘about to be hit’, and the 2017 slip and current D-E1 use that timing. The intermediate publication has no separate executable route. The ability threshold, attached cards and destination are retained.
